items.customer_text: 朝早咖啡飲咗幾啖，杯水仲原封不動？順手飲兩啖先啦。
items.internal_reason: Natural hydration cue built around a familiar morning habit; one gentle action and distinct from recent bottle-at-desk wording.

items.customer_text: 今日如果由朝忙到晚，今晚操少一兩樣都得，留返啲力聽日用。
